conditions.displayName: Cloud Run p95 request latency above 2000ms for 10 minutes

documentation.content: p95 latency breached the 2-second page budget for 10 minutes. Per-route latency lives in the structured `httpRequest` logs emitted by the API envelope (filter on `route`). Check: cold-start storm (min instances), slow Postgres queries, an external service hanging past its timeout, or a regression in the latest revision — roll back with `make rollback`.
